short_explanation: The official record fixes the geography at Queens Block 1791, Lots 52 and 68. The deterministic ZAP BBL match to Queens BBL 4017910052 and archived 2009 Council District 21 is the coherent geography. The AI District 20 claim was only an address/block-lot inference and is not supported by the official LU record. The text-BBL result showing Manhattan BBL 1017910020 is a borough-prefix parsing error and should be ignored.

short_explanation: This roll-call bundled three call-ups. Official LU application records resolve them as Belmont Cove in District 17, 59 Greenwich in District 3, and 51-53 White Street in District 1. The AI was correct for Districts 1 and 3 but wrong to include District 15 for Belmont Cove. The deterministic result correctly found Districts 17 and 3 but missed the 51-53 White Street District 1 component, likely because only two ZAP BBLs were matched for a three-component signature.
